pkgmetadata.longdescription: The Protection Domain mapper answers the service registry lookups of the remote processors on Qualcomm platforms. Firmware running on the ADSP, CDSP and modem asks over QRTR which protection domain provides a given service, and pd-mapper replies with the domain and instance read from the servreg JSON files shipped in the firmware package, decompressing them on the fly when they are stored as .xz.
